deal.name: Share My Image – Video & Image Hosting with Fast Sharing & Secure Storage
deal.tagline: Upload and share videos, Shorts, and images instantly with a clean, fast, and powerful platform.

plans.name: Single
terms: Lifetime access to Image Storage Plan
You must redeem your code within 60 days of purchase

features: Upload Images & Videos up to 1 GB
Images support types - JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF, and WEBP.
Videos support types - MOV, MP4, WebM.
ShareX integration to share screenshots and video screen recording.
Create Folders: Organize your product images efficiently by creating folders and subfolders.
Set folder privacy options: public, private, or password-protected.
Generate and Share Links After Uploading Images.
ShareMyImage.com creates various types of links: Direct links, HTML, Thumbnail, Markdown, BB Code.
Get All Image Links Easily: Retrieve album image links with a single click.
Each folder/album can generate up to 1000 links.
Help for eCommerce Businesses: Create product listings via CSV upload, saving time and effort.
Bulk image management for Amazon, eBay, Flipkart, Shopify, WooCommerce, and other platforms.
Global CDN for faster content access worldwide.
Get a personalized brand URL (e.g., ShareMyImage.com/YourBrand).
Organize and showcase your products' portfolio.
Share URL on WhatsApp, Telegram, and other platforms.

trials.claim: Each folder or album can generate up to 1000 links
trials.claimQuote: Each folder/album can generate up to 1000 links.
trials.reasoning: The vendor directly states a folder can generate a maximum of 1000 links. The prosecution review complains about copying a folder path, but does not dispute the 1000-link limit.

exhibits.quote: Additionally, the platform does not allow sharing an entire folder; when I copy a link, it only includes the last part of the URL, not the full path.
exhibits.argument: This reports folder sharing does not work correctly, undermining the claim that folders can generate up to 1000 usable links.

exhibits.quote: Users can get album images links any time with a single click. Folder can generate a maximum of 1000 links.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states a folder can generate a maximum of 1000 links.

exhibits.quote: User can get Folder images links any time with a single click. Folder can generate a maximum of 1000 links.
exhibits.argument: Vendor repeats that a folder can generate a maximum of 1000 links.

trials.claim: Platform supports uploading and sharing videos, Shorts and images instantly
trials.claimQuote: Upload and share videos, Shorts, and images instantly with a clean, fast, and powerful platform.
trials.reasoning: Two reviews report that around half of images fail when uploading, including in bulk. That materially undercuts the claim of instant, reliable uploading and sharing, despite the listed file types.

exhibits.quote: It seems that when uploading around 10 images at once, only half of them successfully upload.
exhibits.argument: This reports bulk uploads routinely fail, contradicting the claim of instant uploading and sharing.

exhibits.quote: I was enjoying the product for sometime until I realized that at times half my images failed to upload.
exhibits.argument: This reports half of images failed to upload, undermining reliability of instant upload and sharing.

exhibits.quote: User can upload following file type, JPG PNG BMP GIF WEBP, MOV MP4 WEBM up to 1 GB
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms users can upload image and video file types.

exhibits.quote: I use it every day to share videos and images with my clients and team.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms daily sharing of videos and images with clients and team.

trials.claim: Images support JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF and WEBP types
trials.claimQuote: Images support types - JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF, and WEBP.
trials.reasoning: The vendor lists JPG, PNG, BMP, GIF and WEBP as supported upload types. A buyer review also confirms GIF files work.

exhibits.quote: User can upload following file type, JPG PNG BMP GIF WEBP, MOV MP4 WEBM up to 1 GB
exhibits.argument: Vendor lists JPG PNG BMP GIF WEBP as supported upload types.

exhibits.quote: Share My Image produced a full-sized GIF file that I could import using the HTML function.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms GIF files work via the platform.

trials.claim: ShareX integration for screenshots and video screen recording
trials.claimQuote: ShareX integration to share screenshots and video screen recording.
trials.reasoning: A buyer directly confirms ShareX integration sends captured images straight into the platform. The prosecution exhibits concern the vendor's own Windows app, not whether ShareX integration works.

exhibits.quote: There is no Windows application available for download on the official website, despite an announcement on the AppSumo page in September 2025 that an application will be released soon.
exhibits.argument: This reports no Windows app is actually available, undermining the claimed ShareX integration for screenshots and recording.

exhibits.quote: Until that release, users are forced to rely on the web interface, which is not ideal for many workflows.
exhibits.argument: This reports users are limited to the web interface, contradicting a working ShareX desktop integration.

exhibits.quote: The integration of ShareX is a great addition too, I can send captures images straight in Share My Image.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms ShareX integration sends captures straight into Share My Image.
